title: データ解析
subtitle: Data Analysis
keywords: Statistical data 2.Data science 3.Probability distribution 4.Test and estimation 5.Programming
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) Statistical data and data science. (2) Concepts of statistics and probability. (3) Methods for testing and estimation. (4) The basics of programming.
advice: This is a basic data science course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Statistical data 2. Data science 3. Probabilistic distribution 4. Testing and estimation 5. Programming (using R) Students will also learn about advanced issues such as probabilistic modelling, if time permits. Students are expected to understand the basics of data science. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve the exercises independently. Students should pay attention to the teacher’s instructions in the class because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should attend all classes as the handouts may not be received.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Statistics for Bioscience and Chemistry. Sufficient skills of the basics of data science. Basic knowledge of statistics. How to use a personal computer and internet communication technology.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and explain statistical values.
Ability to understand and explain probabilistic distributions
Ability to understand and explain probability for statistics
Ability to choose the appropriate statistical method for your purpose
Ability to operate R (programming using free software)
